lessons.title: natural, dêsign(52w)
lessons.contentHtml:
Read the text and answer the following questions.

In the past, Vietnamese people used natural materials for many aspects of daily life. Houses were made of bamboo, wood, and thatched roofs, while baskets, mats, and furniture were crafted from rattan and palm leaves. Clothes were often woven from cotton or silk and designed simply, which created comfortable and durable outfits.
